source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion: Check all the water-quality tests results in the inspection records to see if the falls within the compliance limits set by Public Health: 1. ​Note: Many monitoring requirements are determined locally according to risk of contamination. 2. ​The EPA's web page about the regulations might mention only national (maximum) limits, which may not be true for your water system, or may not match what you have in your records. 3. If any test result is outside compliance limits, then specifically report that non-compliance. 1. An unwarranted non-compliance report can cost the water system thousands of dollars in time, money, and reputation, and can cost them their EPA inspector too. 2.
